headline: Violent Clashes Reshape Nevish Line as Palantine Berm Ignites
war_summary: Nevish Line has seen Colonial forces claw back ground, shifting the front to three Colonial strongpoints against five Warden amidst furious action along Blackcoat Way. In Kuura Strand, ongoing turmoil over Talven and Menneen produced four base shifts in two hours, leaving Colonials clinging to a solitary redoubt. Meanwhile, fighting has flared sharply in Palantine Berm, where contested struggles over The Pippeli Stones and Windburn Landing generated four recent ownership transitions. Weathered Expanse endures as the theater's bloodiest slaughterhouse, recording five events in two hours across Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance alongside nearly three thousand new casualties. Fresh instability has also cracked open Callahan's Passage, where Crumbling Post and Scáth Passing changed hands in three rapid clashes under accelerating casualty rates. To the west, Mooring County logged a local Colonial capture at The Wind Hills, even as earlier flashpoints at Fisherman's Row, Linn of Mercy, and Stonecradle lapsed into quiet.
